name: CSS Flexbox Playground
summary: Tune flex-direction, wrap, justify, align, and gap with a live preview and copy-ready CSS.
description: Interactive Flexbox playground: adjust flex-direction, flex-wrap, justify-content, align-items, align-content, and gap. Preview items live and copy a .flex-container CSS rule. Everything runs in your browser.

faqs.question: What CSS is generated?
faqs.answer: A .flex-container rule with display:flex plus the properties you set (direction, wrap, justify, align, gap).

faqs.question: Does align-content always matter?
faqs.answer: align-content mainly affects multi-line flex containers (when items wrap onto more than one line).

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The playground runs entirely in your browser.
